## Workload

Elif Sahin completed 361 reads during the quarter, recording 186 hours of work. This represents a rate of 1.9 reads per hour. The workload was documented for review and provides the basis for assessing both output and the quality assurance activity undertaken during the period.

## Quality

A sample of 32 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement was recorded at 37.5 per cent. The review identified borderline background cases, and feedback was provided to support consistent interpretation and decision-making in similar cases.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. The findings should be considered alongside the workload information, including the total reads, hours recorded, and the rate of 1.9 reads per hour.
